guide.title: Before you search
guide.setupFirst: Set up the device in the SG app on your phone first. Homey does not add new devices to the network.
guide.closeApp: Close the SG app on phones and tablets.
guide.near: Keep Homey close to one of the devices.
guide.password: The password is 1234 unless you changed it in the SG app.
guide.passwordAccount: If Homey cannot find the devices or they do not respond, log in with your SG account in the app settings.
guide.durationPill: The search usually takes less than a minute.
guide.loginFirst: First log in with your SG account in the app settings if you have LEDDim Smart 3.0 or don't know the password.
guide.fetchAgain: If you've added devices in the SG app since the last fetch, tap "Fetch again" in the app settings.

account.quiet: These are in your SG account but did not respond: __devices__. Try again closer to them.

account.title: SG account
account.intro: Required for SG Smart 3.0, otherwise optional. Fetches the network password and device names. Your SG password is not stored.
account.unavailable: SG account login is not included in this build.
account.sg3: SG Smart 3.0 devices: __count__. Not supported yet.
account.forgetConfirm: Remove all data fetched from the SG account? Devices that need its password will stop responding.

error.login: SG did not accept the email or password.
error.network: Could not reach SG. Try again.

account.sg3Ready: SG Smart 3.0 devices: __count__. LEDDim Smart 3.0 is added under LEDDim Smart.

keepConnected.label: Keep SG LEDDim Gen1 connected
keepConnected.hint: Enable for faster response. If you have only one Gen1 device, the SG app on your phone cannot connect to it while this setting is on.

sg3KeepConnected.label: Keep SG Smart 3.0 connected
sg3KeepConnected.hint: Enable for faster response. If you have only one 3.0 device, the SG app on your phone cannot connect to it while this setting is on.

signal.title: Signal to Homey
signal.hint: Shown under "Link" when you open a Gen1 dimmer. "Direct" means the dimmer is connected to Homey. Other dimmers are reached through it. Weak signal? Move Homey closer to a dimmer.

otherDevice.title: Which SG devices are supported
otherDevice.rotary: First generation (Gen1, @NDxxxx) has been tested and works. Later generations, including TW, Master and 400 2-pole, are being tested.
otherDevice.pill: , including Micro, TW and Smart Pill ON-OFF: being tested.
otherDevice.thermostat: : being tested. Control from Homey is new, on by default, and can be turned off.
otherDevice.sg3: : LEDDim Smart 3.0 has been tested and works. LEDDim Smart 2-pole 3.0 is being tested. Both need you to log in with your SG account. Other 3.0 products are not supported yet.
otherDevice.other: Other SG devices, such as DIN, Push, Floor and Pill DALI, are not supported yet.
otherDevice.report: Something not working? Report it in the forum thread.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.hint: Only enable when the developer asks. Turn it off before sending a diagnostics report.

log.hint: Shows the latest log lines. Bluetooth addresses and device names are hidden, but the log shows when lights are used. Send it as a private message to the developer in the forum, not in the thread.
log.copyManual: Text selected. Copy with Ctrl+C, or press and hold the text.
log.empty: The log is empty. Use the lights a little, and try again.
log.failed: Could not get the log. Try again in a moment.

device.notHeard: No contact with the dimmer. Wrong password or out of range?
device.waitingForStatus: Waiting for the dimmer's first status.
device.passwordWrong: Possibly wrong network password. Check settings.
device.passwordWrongLogin: Network password may be wrong. Log in with your SG account in the app settings.
device.fakeLeftOver: Test device from a development run. Nothing is sent. Delete it.
device.badMeshId: The device has no valid mesh ID. Delete it and add it again.
device.sg3NoNetwork: Log in with your SG account in the app settings.
device.sg3OtherHome: The dimmer is not in the home fetched from your SG account.
device.sg3NotSent: Could not reach the dimmer. Try again.
device.sg3SettingsFixed: This dimmer gets its password from your SG account. These settings are not used.

notification.passwordWrongLogin: Possibly wrong network password in SG LEDDim. Log in with your SG account in the app settings.

thermostat.controlOff: Control from Homey is off for this thermostat. Turn it on in its settings.
thermostat.waitingForStatus: Waiting for the thermostat's first status.
